Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. Instead of rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now save your exact configuration and return to it in a single click. Set up a view for your sprint backlog, your overdue tasks, or your team's weekly priorities, and it will be there whenever you need it.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize how you work across projects, clients, or workflows without cluttering your task lists. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filters, sort orders, and grouping instead of recreating them from scratch. This makes it easier to align on priorities, onboard new teammates, and keep reporting consistent.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, with no setup required. Whether you manage one project or dozens, this update helps you get back to the view that matters most, faster.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
